packageRules.description: This project has no runtime dependencies. Everything Renovate sees is a development tool or a CI action; group them so review stays one pull request. The pre-commit manager is off by default in Renovate, so the pinned revisions would otherwise drift away from the versions in the lockfile and give a different verdict.
Linters change what the build accepts. Their major versions are reviewed one at a time.

The interpreter in .python-version is the floor this project promises, not the newest it supports. Raising it would have development run on 3.14 while requires-python still says >=3.11, and a 3.12 syntax would pass unnoticed until CI. The version matrix in quality.yml is what covers the newer interpreters.
